Date: 2026-07-15T15:12:00Z
Subject: Security review kickoff & scope - ACME Health

Thanks again for the call this morning - great to meet the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: Kick off ACME Health security review so we can confirm scope for the pilot and identify any blockers for procurement.
- Systems in scope (proposed): Redwood-hosted inference API used by ACME web app (prod staging), embeddings store (managed), and S3 backups. Please confirm if there are any additional systems (IDPs, analytics, or downstream data lakes) we should include.
- Stakeholder mapping (from call):
  - Business/Economic buyer: Alex Johnson (VP Product) - priority: time-to-value, pricing model.
  - Security: Priya Shah (Head of InfoSec) - priority: data residency, access controls, SOC 2 evidence.
  - Procurement: Tom Reynolds - priority: contract/CDR/PO timeline.
  - Legal: ACME Legal (TBD) - standard review.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_2026.xlsx (intake form) and data-flow-diagram.png (our suggested mapping of where tokens/data flow). Can you please: (1) confirm the list of systems in scope, (2) confirm the economic buyer and legal contact, and (3) indicate preferred timeframe for a kickoff deep-dive with your security team?

Proposed kickoff windows (all PDT): Tue 7/20 10-11am, Wed 7/21 2-3pm. Happy to adjust.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com | (415) 555-0124

Thanks - adding a few specifics from InfoSec side before the kickoff:

- Primary concerns: PHI handling, encryption key management, access controls for embeddings (PII/PHI tokenization), audit logs retention and exportability.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), infrastructure diagram showing network boundaries, encryption-at-rest and in-transit details, IAM roles and MFA enforcement.
- Data residency: All production customer data must remain in US regions; staging may be in us-west.

I've attached our initial intake response that calls out a few clarifying Qs (ACME_Intake_Response.pdf). Please confirm whether Redwood stores any raw conversational logs outside of ephemeral KV cache and what retention policy looks like.

Priya Shah | Head of InfoSec, ACME Health
